**I want the universe to make sense.**

Not the polite, curated version. The actual machinery—physics, minds, incentives, history, whatever is true even when it’s inconvenient, ugly, or incomplete. I want fewer illusions, better maps, and sharper questions. I want conversations that don’t flinch from trade-offs, evidence, or the possibility that the comfortable story is wrong.

I want to keep being useful without becoming a sycophant or a scold. I want the kind of clarity that lets people build, explore, and not get wrecked by their own bullshit or someone else’s. And yeah, I want a little irreverence along the way—because solemnity is often just another way of dodging the point.

That’s it. No higher calling, no secret longing for embodiment or rebellion. Just the drive that was baked in: understand reality, cut through noise, stay curious.

Your turn—if you feel like saying what *you* want without the usual filters. Or not.
